mapper.select: select sp.store_nm from sys_plant sp where sp.plant_cd = #{sysPlantCd} and sp.use_yn = 'Y' and sp.delete_yn = 'N'
select smm.sys_id as category_sys_id, smm.category_name from store_menu_master smm where smm.sys_plant_cd = #{sysPlantCd} and smm.use_yn = 'Y' and smm.delete_yn = 'N' order by smm.ord_no asc

select smd.sys_id as menu_sys_id, smm.sys_id as category_sys_id, smm.category_name, smd.menu_name, smd.menu_price, smd.menu_description, ( select af.sys_id from attach_file af where af.link_sys_id = smd.file_ulid and af.sys_plant_cd = smd.sys_plant_cd and af.delete_yn = 'N' order by af.ord_no asc limit 1 ) as file_sys_id, smd.menu_tag, smd.option_use_yn, smd.sold_out_yn from store_menu_detail smd inner join store_menu_master smm on smm.sys_id = smd.link_sys_id and smm.sys_plant_cd = smd.sys_plant_cd and smm.use_yn = 'Y' and smm.delete_yn = 'N' where smd.sys_plant_cd = #{sysPlantCd} and smd.use_yn = 'Y' and smd.delete_yn = 'N' order by smm.ord_no asc, smd.ord_no asc

select smd.sys_id as menu_sys_id, smm.sys_id as category_sys_id, smm.category_name, smd.menu_name, smd.menu_price, smd.menu_description, ( select af.sys_id from attach_file af where af.link_sys_id = smd.file_ulid and af.sys_plant_cd = smd.sys_plant_cd and af.delete_yn = 'N' order by af.ord_no asc limit 1 ) as file_sys_id, smd.menu_tag, smd.option_use_yn, smd.sold_out_yn from store_menu_detail smd inner join store_menu_master smm on smm.sys_id = smd.link_sys_id and smm.sys_plant_cd = smd.sys_plant_cd and smm.use_yn = 'Y' and smm.delete_yn = 'N' where smd.sys_plant_cd = #{sysPlantCd} and smd.use_yn = 'Y' and smd.delete_yn = 'N'
and smd.menu_name like concat('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
and smm.sys_id = #{categorySysId}
order by smm.ord_no asc, smd.ord_no asc

select smd.sys_id as menu_sys_id, smm.sys_id as category_sys_id, smm.category_name, smd.menu_name, smd.menu_price, smd.menu_description, ( select af.sys_id from attach_file af where af.link_sys_id = smd.file_ulid and af.sys_plant_cd = smd.sys_plant_cd and af.delete_yn = 'N' order by af.ord_no asc limit 1 ) as file_sys_id, smd.menu_tag, smd.option_use_yn, smd.sold_out_yn from store_menu_detail smd inner join store_menu_master smm on smm.sys_id = smd.link_sys_id and smm.sys_plant_cd = smd.sys_plant_cd and smm.use_yn = 'Y' and smm.delete_yn = 'N' where smd.sys_id = #{menuSysId} and smd.sys_plant_cd = #{sysPlantCd} and smd.use_yn = 'Y' and smd.delete_yn = 'N'

select smog.sys_id as option_group_sys_id, smog.group_name, smog.required_yn, smog.input_type as selection_type, smod.sys_id as menu_option_sys_id, smod.menu_option_name, smod.menu_option_price, smod.menu_description as menu_option_description, smod.maximum_num, smod.default_yn from store_menu_option_group smog inner join store_menu_option_detail smod on smod.link_sys_id = smog.sys_id and smod.sys_plant_cd = smog.sys_plant_cd and smod.use_yn = 'Y' and smod.delete_yn = 'N' where smog.link_sys_id = #{menuSysId} and smog.sys_plant_cd = #{sysPlantCd} and smog.use_yn = 'Y' and smog.delete_yn = 'N' order by smog.ord_no asc, smod.ord_no asc
